name: components-community-share-button
blurb: Share button reveals Github, X, and Facebook icons on hover.
description: A Framer Motion-powered button that swaps between a label and animated social icons on hover, with staggered entrance animations and spring physics.
use_when: You need an engaging way to show social share options without taking up initial space.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices where hover is not reliable; the icons only appear on mouse enter.
a11y: Button triggers content swap but no aria attributes for icon meanings. Social icons clickable but unlabeled beyond the platform name in context.
